conflicts.description: Many unrelated files are modified or untracked. The Wages redesign must not stage, revert, or overwrite other work.
conflicts.strategy: Scope edits to WagesSummaryRebinmasPage, Wages Rebinmas CSS, and focused tests only.
conflicts.impact: Low if file scope is respected.

conflicts.description: Three CSS files define print behavior for .wsp-document and Wages Rebinmas tables.
conflicts.strategy: Add narrowly scoped selectors under .wages-rebinmas-print-document and new print page classes, then lock with CSS tests.
conflicts.impact: Prevents regressions to Summary Report, THR, and comparison print modes.

conflicts.description: WagesSummaryRebinmasPage contains state, data shaping, toolbar, tables, print layout, and mode switching in one file.
conflicts.strategy: Extract only low-risk pure helpers/components needed for audit pages and keep mode state in the existing page.
conflicts.impact: Improves maintainability without a broad rewrite.
